description: In the modern world, Xu Fei is a college student who seems to have nothing going for him: no attractiveness, no family wealth, and no promising future. In parallel, another world exists: a realm where martial artists, spiritual cultivators and sorcerers hold power. In this world, personal strength is the supreme currency, capable of subduing modern society, although its users cannot challenge a thousand adversaries simultaneously or tear heaven and earth with their skills, reflecting an era similar to that of the ancient times. In this realm, things like healthcare, production, and political structures are rudimentary and scarce. Discover how Xu Fei, against all odds, transforms his destiny, becoming a living legend who dominates both the modern and ancient worlds. Prepare for a story of adventure, power and unexpected triumphs, where limits are just the beginning of a new dawn.
